title.narrative: Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP) - Core Support 2021 - 2024

description.narrative: Core support to Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAPs) new 4 years business plan 2021-2024 assisting low and middle-income countries reduce poverty and boost growth through sustainable energy solutions. The agreement also has some earmarking of funds for the Accelerating Regional Energy Project MDTF (AREP). ESMAP has built considerable momentum for closing gender gaps through its global Gender and Energy Program, which includes six regional gender programs. By late 2023 the main reciepient countries have been Dominica, South Africa, India, Pakistan, Tunisia, Vietnam, Ethiopia, China, Kyrgyz Republic, Nigeria, Ukraine and Iraq.
